businesses.business: sleep apnea and respiratory care devices and software

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures CPAP and bi-level devices, masks and accessories for sleep apnea and chronic respiratory disease, sold to home medical equipment providers, distributors and patients. Also provides cloud-connected care management software for home health and senior living providers.

primary_products.value: CPAP and bi-level flow generators; sleep apnea masks and accessories; ventilators; oxygen concentrators

primary_services.value: cloud-based patient monitoring software; care management software for home health and senior living; remote patient engagement platforms

customer_segment.value: B2B: home medical equipment providers, distributors, hospitals, physicians, home health and senior living operators; B2C: patients buying masks and supplies online; B2G: government health programs and public hospital tenders

end_markets.value: healthcare; sleep medicine; respiratory care; home health; senior living

revenue_model.value: product sales: devices, masks and accessories sold to providers, distributors and patients; subscription: software-as-a-service for care management and patient monitoring

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures respiratory devices and masks from purchased components, sold to providers and distributors; software / platform: cloud and care software sold to home health, senior living and sleep providers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other markets in over 140 countries

specialization.value: related lines: sleep and respiratory devices, masks, and connected care software for the same providers and patients

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: home medical equipment providers and distributors; direct sales: hospitals, health systems and software customers; online: direct-to-patient mask and supply sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices requiring FDA clearance and equivalent approvals abroad, reimbursement and data privacy rules
